The scSTAMP-seq 10X ‘inner’ and ‘outer’ PHO primers were mixed to a working concentration of 2.5 μM. Next, the following cDNA amplification master-mix was made: 50 μL 10X amplification master mix, 15 μL 10X cDNA primer mix, 1 μL scSTAMP-seq 10X primer mix.
value_changes.new_value: Then, cDNA amplification was performed and an SPRI size selection was performed by incubating samples for 30 minutes with 0.6x AMPure XP paramagnetic SPRI beads to separate spatial and endogenous cDNA fractions. Next, the small molecule spatial barcode fraction was separated from endogenous transcript cDNA using the same strategy as described in the plate-based library preparation method above.

Separate bulk HeLa gDNA calibration source, obtained by the primary’s delegated isolation procedure. It is not mixed with single-cell material. Registered dependency describes the analogous preparation on H9 gDNA; substrate attribution is retained.
Live HeLa or U2OS cultured cells selected for this implementation; cultured monolayers are supported. Delivery and accuracy in dense or pronounced 3D tissue remain unestablished.
Manufacturer remainder: 30 µL/75% of purified cDNA reserved rather than consumed in this gene-expression library. Primary does not separately report use of this reserve.

Optional source-described MAT 5-kb binary-bin accessibility/methylation clusters and transcriptome-defined pseudobulks; HeLa/U2OS comparison uses top 2% variable bins. Figure14 minimum 15,000 has no unambiguous variable assignment here.
Optional MAT regional comparison profiles: CPM-normalized and 75-bp moving-average data; within-sample regional comparisons additionally normalized to bulk naked-DNA detected sites.

Optional post/pre-cleavage fluorescence observations confirming PHO cleavage. Initial dual-color gradient characterization uses normalized Cy5/Cy3 over 23 s; later outer-only designs use one plane/channel. These observations are not an exposure-adjustment controller.

Known illumination-level identities for the reference/error-correction cohorts; the six-PHO demonstration used five distinct levels. Ground-truth level labels are separate from unknown-sample predictions.
Demonstrated nested masks: PHO1 illuminate Q2–Q4, PHO2 Q3–Q4, PHO3 Q4; these are cumulative nested impressions, not arbitrary independent persistent bits.

Author-designed IDT PHO and CMO-anchor oligos: PHO comprises linked 50-nt inner/50-nt outer DNA halves, each with 20-nt PCR handle, 4-nt inner/outer barcode, random 6-nt UMI and poly-A20; the inner handle binds the anchor. Exact bases and photolabile modification notation are unavailable with Table 1.

Selected light pattern/dose design linking position or known treatment to illumination. DMD masks/gradients and broad-area floodlight doses are alternatives; imposed design must accompany later ratio interpretation.

Same-cell spatially attributed RNA, DNA accessibility and methylation datasets for the MAT route; cell/origin tags connect modalities and exposure interpretation. Feasibility demonstrated with floodlight; general spatial-pattern architecture is described, without proof of every combination.
Bioanalyzer spatial-library fragment-size distribution; no source-reported adaptive decision rule.

Source-described spatially attributed single-cell transcriptomes: route-specific RNA data linked by cell identity to PHO-derived spatial/exposure or quadrant assignments, and optional sample identity. Qualified decoder and route limits remain attached.
